newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney starts seven biotechs, raises one.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney starts seven biotechs, raises one.

text.p: Smith Barney said analyst Reijer Lenstra initiated coverage of seven biotech stocks and upgraded one.

The analyst's office said he started Incyte Pharmaceuticals Inc with a buy-venture rating, Sequana Therapapeutics Inc with outperform-venture, Myriad Genetics Inc with outperform-venture, Millenium Pharmaceuticals Inc with neutral-venture, Genome Therapeutics Inc with neutral-venture, Affymetrix Inc with neutral venture and Genset ADR with underperform venture.
He raised his rating on of Human Genome Sciences Inc to buy-venture from venture.
Further details were not immediately available.
